title: Depletion and reconstitution of macrophages in mice with vesicular stomatitis virus infection
protocol: Intraperitoneally inject CD45.2+ C57BL/6J mice with 0.7–1 mL sterile 6% starch solution.
Sacrifice the mice by anesthesia 3 days after injection.
Soak the mice in 75% alcohol for 3 min and then move them to the ultra-clean workbench.
Cut the skin of mice to expose the peritoneum.
Make a small incision in the center of the peritoneum using scissors carefully.
Irrigate the peritoneum with 1 mL sterile PBS using a sterile dropper.
Irrigate the peritoneal cavity gently with an irrigating solution until it becomes clear.
Centrifuge the irrigating solution at 500 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatants from the centrifuged solution.
Resuspend cell pellets in 3 mL mouse RBC lysis buffer if red blood cells are present, place on ice for 5 minutes, then centrifuge again at 500 × g for 5 minutes and discard the supernatants.
Wash the cell pellets with 5 mL PBS after RBC lysis and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes before discarding the supernatants once more.
Suspend the cell pellets using DMEM medium supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% penicillin–streptomycin.
Adjust the cell density to 2 × 10^6/mL.
Seed the cells on 10 cm cell culture dishes.
Place the dishes at 37°C under 5% CO2 for 4 hours.
Discard the supernatants to remove unattached cells.
Wash the dishes with PBS.
Add fresh DMEM medium supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% penicillin–streptomycin.
Culture the cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Intraperitoneally inject CD45.1+ C57BL/6J mice with 200 μL sterile clodronate liposome.
Scrape CD45.2+ donor peritoneal macrophages from culture dish by a cell scraper.
Count cells and adjust density to 2×10^7/mL.
Gently vortex the cell suspension.
Fill a 1 mL syringe with 100 μL cell suspension.
Place a heater around the mice for 10 min to dilate the tail veins.
Find the tail veins of CD45.1+ recipient mice and clean them with alcohol swabs.
Insert the needle at an angle parallel to the tail veins and inject 100 μL cell suspension (2×10^6 cells).
Remove the needle and apply pressure to the injection site with gauze until there is no more bleeding.
Rapidly thaw VSV.
Intraperitoneally inject VSV into CD45.1+ recipient mice (5 × 10^7 PFU per mouse).
Sacrifice the mice after anesthesia 24 hours later.
